title: Keto Chicken Quesadilla
description: A twist on the classic, this keto version uses a low-carb tortilla and serves with a fresh side of salsa.
instructions: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Season the chicken breast with salt and black pepper.
Cook the chicken for 5-6 minutes per side or until it reaches an internal temperature of 165°F (74°C).
Once the chicken is cooked, let it rest for 5 minutes before slicing it into thin strips.
Meanwhile, heat a skillet over medium heat and add the low-carb tortilla.
Place the cheese on half of the tortilla and top with the chicken strips.
Fold the tortilla in half and cook for 2-3 minutes or until the cheese is melted and the tortilla is crispy.
Flip the quesadilla and cook for another 2-3 minutes or until the other side is also crispy.
Serve with a side of salsa and enjoy!
To make the salsa, simply combine diced tomatoes, red onion, jalapeno, cilantro, and lime juice in a bowl and stir to combine.
